slides.title: Medical Experts
slides.body:
Every client is supported by a carefully selected, in-house team of medical and therapeutic specialists. Psychiatrists, psychotherapists, internal medicine and longevity doctors, precision medicine experts, nurses, nutritionists and complementary therapists work together as one coordinated team.

This close collaboration creates a complete understanding of the client’s health and ensures that every decision is made with clinical precision, continuity and care. At Kusnacht Practice, we have more doctors than clients.

slides.title: Dr. med. univ. László Ürögi — Chief Medical Officer
slides.body: As Chief Medical Officer, Dr. med. univ. László Ürögi brings exceptional clinical leadership to every aspect of care at The Kusnacht Practice. With deep expertise in complex, highly individualised treatment, he oversees the medical direction of all programmes — ensuring that every clinical decision is grounded in precision, integrity and the highest standards of medical excellence. For referring physicians and family offices, his role provides an important assurance: that each client is in the hands of a consummate medical professional whose sole focus is their wellbeing.

slides.title: Dr. med. vet. Antoinette Sarasin Gianduzzo — Founder of the BIO-R® Method & Member of the Board of Directors
slides.body: Dr. med. vet. Antoinette Sarasin Gianduzzo is the originating mind behind the BIO-R® Method — a proprietary, science-led approach to biochemical restoration that sits at the heart of The Kusnacht Practice's precision medicine offering. As a Member of the Board of Directors, she brings both strategic oversight and deep clinical authority to the organisation. Her work bridges the rigour of veterinary and human medicine, translating complex biochemical science into highly personalised treatment protocols. For referring physicians, her presence is a mark of clinical credibility; for family offices, it is an assurance that their clients' care is guided by a pioneer who has dedicated her career to advancing what individualised medicine can achieve.

slides.title: Prof. Dr. med. Alfred Mahr — Specialist in Internal Medicine
slides.body: Prof. Dr. med. Alfred Mahr is a distinguished Specialist in Internal Medicine whose career spans both rigorous clinical practice and leading academic research. His dual expertise brings an important dimension to The Kusnacht Practice: the ability to assess and manage complex internal medicine presentations within a holistic, precision-led framework. For referring physicians, Prof. Mahr represents a peer of the highest calibre — a clinician who understands the nuance of complex cases and applies the latest evidence-based thinking to every treatment decision. His presence ensures that each client's internal health is assessed with the same depth and rigour that defines the practice as a whole.

slides.title: Raluca Babota — Clinical Director
slides.body: As Clinical Director, Raluca Babota holds a pivotal role in translating clinical excellence into a seamless, end-to-end client experience. She oversees the operational and clinical coordination of each programme, ensuring that every stage — from initial referral through to discharge — is managed with precision, discretion and the highest professional standards. For referring physicians and family offices, Raluca is a trusted point of contact who understands both the clinical and personal sensitivities involved. Her leadership ensures that partners can refer with complete confidence, knowing that every detail will be handled with the utmost care.
